purpose: Closed-eyelid reference frames; the game uses only localized eyelid texture crops. Body motion uses original approved textures and Rive mesh skinning.

prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this exact existing clearly adult woman aged 30, Lyra Voss, for ONE closed-eye blink reference frame for a 2D game rig. Change ONLY her eyes: both eyelids gently closed in a natural blink, eyelashes visible, relaxed expression, no smile change. Keep the exact same adult face identity, head angle and location, skin texture, eyebrows, nose, mouth, hair, fully clothed ivory/gold costume, hands, pose, weapon, cape, colors, lighting, image dimensions and pixel registration. Do not move, scale, recenter, crop or redesign anything. Same portrait canvas 1024 by 1536 with same transparent background and subject placement. Everything except the two small eyelid regions must remain visually identical to the reference. No text, scenery or extra elements.
